title: Liria 02 – The Apprentice's Idea
summary: The rhythmic tapping of a hammer led Liria into a small workshop. Among gears, tools, and half-finished devices, she discovered a young apprentice desperately working on a strange machine.
story:
The rhythmic tapping of a hammer led Liria into a small workshop. Among gears, tools, and half-finished devices, she discovered a young apprentice desperately working on a strange machine.

"What's it supposed to do?" Liria asked curiously.

"A lantern powered by its own magical energy," he replied. "But the crystal keeps overheating."

Liria studied the construction. A faint hum came from the crystal, which glowed a bluish light.

"And what happens to the excess energy?"

The apprentice opened his mouth, paused, and looked at the gears.

"I... didn't provide anywhere for it to go."

Liria smiled. "Then perhaps you've just discovered what your invention is missing."

Together they searched for suitable components. The apprentice added a small energy circuit and tried again.

This time the lantern came to life with a gentle, steady glow.

"It works!" he exclaimed.

Liria clapped her hands in delight.

When the workshop master returned, he found his apprentice beaming before a working invention.

The mysterious visitor had already vanished.

As she made her way through the city, Liria smiled at the thought that sometimes the greatest discoveries were only a single question away.
